newsitem.title: UK: Tesco, Safeway may offer health cover.
newsitem.headline: Tesco, Safeway may offer health cover.

text.p: UK supermarket giants Tesco Plc and Safeway Plc are considering offering customers health insurance in a fresh escalation in the food- sales war to retain customer loyalty, The Times said on Monday.
The report said Safeway is expected to offer medical insurance cover from Norwich Union Healthcare which supplies products to Abbey National -- Safeway's banking partner.

Tesco is examining a free insurance scheme for customers holding its loyalty bonus Clubcard. Under the scheme stores will pay for groceries if the customer is made redundant or becomes too ill to work.

The move marks the latest shift by the supermarket chains from exclusive food retailing and into other services including banking as a way of securing customer loyalty in a fiercely competitive marketplace. --London newsroom +44 171 5427717
